Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Class: EQ Heavy SMG
Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Foregrip, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Single Shot fires a 3-round burst (empties the magazine if fewer remain). Autofire only while the Tech Rebuild is charged. Counts as one Superchrome Coating installation when carried openly. Held two-handed, grants a +1 Complementary Bonus to Aimed Shots and Autofire checks (Excellent Quality + Foregrip).

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
